title: Gate count and program offset
statement: Let $m,w,n$ be natural numbers, let $$ be a type with a chosen default element, let $F$ assign a Boolean-list function to each element of $$, and let $P$ be a finite list of instructions whose kinds lie in $$. For each index $i$ with $i |P|$, the number of input vertices plus the number of gates in the circuit generated from the first $i$ instructions equals the base vertex index assigned to stage $i$.
hypotheses_covered: A type of instruction kinds with a chosen default element
A function assigning a Boolean-list function to each instruction kind
A finite program of instructions of those kinds
